title: spec: a `tree` field with no `reference` is accepted as a self-reference and materializes `set_null`, yet no reader resolves it, so no delete walk reaches it; settle one reading (plus two field.zod.ts comments false once PR #23055 lands)
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (b): two readings of one declared shape, and the runtime honours neither. `reach:` the public door, measured. On a stack booted with `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack`, at PR #23055's head, one object declares a field `{ type: 'tree' }` with no `reference`. After POSTing a parent and a child pointing at it, `DELETE` of the parent answers `200` and the child still holds the deleted id. The engine's system delete with `SqlDriver` gives the same result.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 2 (#20966) · `os-steve` · `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX` · 2026-10-12T15:29Z. It comes from #22957's dev (os-dev-report 6125920806, out-of-scope finding 1) and the contract-tier record on PR #23055 (6127360226), which escalated it as a spec reading. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's. Likely `domain:spec` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`), and then the engine consumes the answer.

## The two readings, both on `main`
- `ObjectSchema` accepts a `tree` with no `reference` as a reference to its own object (`refuseForeignTreeReference`, whose guidance says to drop `reference`), and `FieldSchema` materializes `set_null` on it.
- `referenceTargetOf` answers `undefined` for such a field, and its docblock calls it "an authoring bug". `referenceCarrierOf` reads `reference` only, and `IMPLICIT_REFERENCE_TARGETS` holds `user` only. So the delete walk that #22957 widened to `tree` never reaches it.
- The contract record notes that no shipped corpus row is in the gap today: the showcase's `f_tree` carries `reference`, and `platform-objects` has no `tree` field.

## Wanted: one reading, enforced
Either a referenceless `tree` IS a self-reference (the engine's reference readers take the field's own object, and the declared `deleteBehavior` then takes effect), or it is refused at parse with a located message (and `refuseForeignTreeReference`'s guidance stops telling authors to drop `reference`). ⛔ Not a consumer fallback in one reader.

## Carried here: two `field.zod.ts` comment sites, false once PR #23055 lands
- the `deleteBehavior` TSDoc's #9784 paragraph (the engine reads the key only behind a `master_detail` / `lookup` guard);
- the `.overwrite` block's sentence that `cascadeDeleteRelations` reaches the key "exclusively on `master_detail` / `lookup` fields", and its `user` sentence ("sits outside today's cascade guard exactly like `text` does").

After #22957, the walk's family is `master_detail`, `lookup` and `tree`. The contract record placed both sites with this card: same file, same `tree` delete-semantics reading.

Dedupe: `git grep` and a search of the issues for "referenceless tree", "tree without reference", "referenceTargetOf tree" found no open card.
